原文: The reason for this campaign is not to endorse, glorify or promote Nazism/Fascism.  I am deeply opposed to such views and consider them abhorrant in the extreme.  That being said, one can not deny the fighting abilities or grit and fanatacism of this certain divsion of the Waffen SS.  I merely wish to tell the story of one of the most interesting and controversial units of the Second World War, and to try and immerse the player into the battle's represented.  As well as detailing the fighting exploits of the Leibstandarte, I have included at certain points of the campaign details of attrocities carried out by Leibstandarte members.  This is done to give a sense of perspective.  I hope you enjoy the campaign.
